Subject: Request: credit memo for trial overage credits (Appfolio Labs)

Hi Irene —

Thanks again for the pilot support. We finished our trial and found we were over the allotted token credits for tenant appfolio-prod during the last two weeks (see attached usage summary). Our procurement team asked whether Redwood can issue a credit memo for the overage promo credits and either:

- apply it as an invoice offset against the July invoice, or
- issue a credit memo now and we’ll apply it on our next remittance (we have a restricted AP window so prefer a PDF/DocuSign-ready memo).

Can you confirm how Redwood treats these promotional credits from an accounting standpoint (GL impact, whether it reduces recognized revenue vs. a contra-revenue entry), and whether you can route this as an invoice offset? If you need the PO reference: PO-32219.

Appfolio contact for billing: billing@applabs.com.

Appreciate a quick runbook so we can close our month.

— Cassandra

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Cassandra Lee <cassandra@applabs.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: credit memo for trial overage credits (Appfolio Labs)

All — quick read: looks straightforward. Proposed approach (high level):

1) Issue a credit memo for the promo overage amount (line-level credit tied to promo allowance) — this is easiest for Appfolio to route into AP;
2) Book as contra-revenue (GL suggestion below) vs. reducing recognized revenue — since promotion was pre-sale and not part of recognized GAAP revenue, we typically use a contra-revenue account for promo allowances; if they had recognized deferred revenue tied to the trial there would be an alternative treatment.
3) Provide a PDF credit memo and a DocuSign envelope if Appfolio needs signed paperwork; we can also offer to apply as invoice offset on the July invoice if their AP team confirms acceptance and provides remittance instructions.

Suggested GL mapping (draft):
- Promo allowance / contra-revenue: 6405
- Accounts receivable reduction (when applied): 1100
- Revenue reversal (if required by accounting): 4201

I've attached a draft credit memo (tenant_credit_memo_draft.pdf) and a quick CSV of the suggested mapping (acct_mapping.csv). Vanessa — can revenue ops confirm the contra-revenue account and whether we need a formal finance approval for a credit under $5k?

Marissa
Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: tenant_credit_memo_draft.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Cassandra Lee <cassandra@applabs.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: credit memo for trial overage credits (Appfolio Labs)

Thanks team — verified with Revenue policy: we can proceed with a credit memo recorded to contra-revenue (GL 6405). Operational notes:

- Book the credit memo now (CM-2026-072) and attach to customer file; when applied to open AR use 1100 to reduce A/R.
- If the customer prefers an invoice offset we can apply the credit to the July invoice, but accounting will still record the credit memo in the month issued and then apply a JE at time of application.
- For revenue recognition: because this was promotional and not invoiced as standard billable usage, contra-revenue is appropriate; no impact to previously recognized revenue.
- Approval: credits under $5,000 can be approved by Revenue Ops. Please confirm the exact amount and have the customer sign the DocuSign envelope if they require a signed memo.

Next steps (action items):
1) Marissa to prepare final credit memo PDF and start DocuSign envelope for Appfolio billing contact.
2) Irene to confirm whether Appfolio wants the credit applied to July invoice or sent as a standalone memo.
3) Vanessa to confirm GL 6405 is the final contra-revenue mapping and confirm JE template for application.
4) Sean to provide CM number once recorded.

--
Sean Gallagher
Head of Accounting, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: acct_mapping.csv (CSV, 4KB)]
